versions.content: To serialize the required AUTOSAR data types (signed- and un- signed integer) from the request message / into the response message of UDS Service RoutineControl, the target endianness configured in DcmDspRoutineSignalEndi- anness shall be considered for DcmDspRoutine signals having set to fixed length ( DcmDspRoutineSignalType set to other value than VARIABLE_LENGTH ).
